summary: Frontend-only testing of 4 new modal enhancements (Salin teks, Unduh PNG, tilegram2-hex-opens-modal, Cetak) plus regression of the 8 base click-to-interpret elements. All features work correctly with zero JS console errors. One minor testability fix applied: added missing data-testid='interp-umpan' to the feedback span.
critical_code_review_comments: Playwright test note: page.click(..., force=True) on #cetak fires the click event twice in this environment (2 print calls). Normal page.click() fires once. This is a testing quirk (Playwright's forced click dispatches mousedown+mouseup+click that some renderers duplicate), NOT an app bug. Verified with dispatchEvent/native click(): both produce exactly 1 CLICK event and 1 window.print() invocation. Recommendation for future tests: click btn-cetak WITHOUT force=True.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features verified: (1) Salin teks - #interp-umpan shows 'Teks tersalin ✓' and clipboard contents include the modal title (verified with clipboard permissions granted). (2) Unduh PNG - download triggered with filename 'interpretasi-restoran.png' matching pattern 'interpretasi-*.png'. (2b) Share button - correctly hidden in headless Chromium (navigator.share undefined, el.hidden=true). (3) Tilegram2 hexagons in Profil kecamatan section now open interp-dialog with #interp-judul == kecamatan name AND #k-nama side card also updates. Hero tilegram still works. (4) Cetak button invokes window.print exactly once (when clicked without force=True). Zero console errors across all interactions. Regression: bar-subsektor-0, kartu-klaster-0, kartu-prioritas-Cakung, row-sensitivitas-0, row-lokasi-0, figure-kepadatan, figure-lisa, figure-akses all open modal with non-empty title+text and close cleanly via interp-close. Minor fix applied: index.html line 345 now has data-testid='interp-umpan' on the feedback span.
rca of the issue: None. Site behavior fully matches spec.
